about_short_description.short_description: Leafpress is an information technology company that offers data collection services.

product.name: AI Utility Data Collection
product.description: Automates collection and processing of utility billing, usage, and rate data from multiple sources to provide accurate energy information.

product.name: Interconnection AI
product.description: Provides AI-driven analysis of grid interconnection feasibility using real-time grid models and injection studies to predict project approval likelihood.

product.name: Site Selection AI
product.description: Enables rapid identification and evaluation of energy project sites by analyzing grid constraints, zoning laws, and permitting risks.

product.name: Document Intelligence AI
product.description: Extracts, summarizes, and analyzes data from permitting documents, regulatory filings, interconnection studies, and utility reports using AI.

product.name: Community Sentiment & Zoning AI
product.description: Analyzes zoning laws, permitting trends, and local opposition to assess risks for energy project development.

product.name: API Suite
product.description: Offers developer-friendly APIs for real-time utility rates, energy data collection, and interconnection intelligence integration.
